task_objective: Phase 1: Build an exhaustive, cross-linked, metadata-only HTML developer guide (and machine-readable data.json) for Steam Deck publicbeta Vite/Rolldown bundles styled with Valve's Steam Deck / SteamUI color guide, bridging Vite hashes and runtime exports back to pre-Vite Webpack equivalents.
tests_added: tools/dev_guide.test.ts (14 unit tests covering Valve palette tokens, feature-area classification, strict public Valve-asset boundary validation, CSS index assembly, single-pass Vite AST chunk analysis, dual-bundle Webpack->Vite fingerprint matching, semantic naming & recipe sanitization, HTML split/single-file rendering, client JS syntax validation, and CLI mapping-data helpers)
design_decisions: Split guide client runtime into tools/dev_guide_client.js so it is syntax-checked directly by Acorn in tests and avoids nested template-literal escaping bugs.
Styled the HTML UI with Valve's Steam Deck GamepadUI (--gpSystem* / --gpStore* / --gpColor-*) and Steam Brand color guide tokens.
Enforced strict Valve-asset boundary in validatePublicGuideData() and buildExportRecipe(), rejecting raw JS bodies, verbatim CSS blocks, and SVG markup before writing outputs.

Used an inverted-index dual-bundle matcher (translating Vite CSS hashes to semantic CSS keys) to match thousands of unnamed JS exports across Webpack -> Vite in milliseconds, with optional --save-webpack-baseline / --webpack-baseline caching.
Filtered generated protobuf message classes and private _-prefixed method noise from inferred helpers to keep data.json crisp (~11 MB raw, virtualized to ~16 DOM rows in browser).

results.unit_tests: All 74 Bun tests pass; Python unittest and ty check verified clean.

live_verification_beta_1795048523.browser_smoke: Verified in headless Chrome 150: #comp/SliderField deep-link, 16-row virtualization over 22,747 searchable items, omnibox Vite-hash search (cpMYQEmzrwE- -> Keyboard.Keyboard), cross-linked drawer, and CSS Paste Translator.
